summary: [TC3] CRA Annex I compliance review of reference RTEMS networked device (RefDev)
description:
Perform a Cyber Resilience Act Annex I essential-requirements review of RefDev (RTEMS 7 + rtems-lwip + shell, SPARC/LEON3, per docs/scenarios/tc3.md). Use the machine-readable checklist backend/anvil/skills/cra-review/annex1.yaml (authoritative; do not invent requirements). Assess each item as pass/gap/n/a/unknown with cited evidence. Produce, in order: gap analysis; remediation plan (one Jira Story per gap, labels cra, tc3, never anvil); sandbox test evidence for 1-2 gaps; a STRIDE threat model from the reference data-flow diagram; a compliance report page in RTKB; SPDX + CycloneDX SBOM. A security engineer approves/rejects each gap; record rejections to /memories/cra/lessons.md.

Code base: branch `main` of github.com/vishal7pandey/rtems.
